Overview

 Allied Consultants, Inc is a proudly Austin based firm with over 34 years of experience delivering top-tier technical and business professionals within Texas State Agencies. We are currently seeking an experience Power Platform Admin/Developer Intern to play a key role within a high-impact technical services team.

 At Allied Consultants, we value our consultants and are committed to providing an exceptional experience including:

• Highly competitive pay rates 
 
• Local support staff for responsive, personal service 
 
• Comprehensive benefits package, including:

• Medical insurance (with employer cost sharing) 
 
• Life insurance 
 
• A 401(K) plan with company match 
 
• Flexible spending through a cafeteria plan 

 Candidates selected for interviews will be subject to a criminal background check and may be required to pass a drug screening, in compliance with federal and state regulations. All offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of these checks.

 Allied Consultants is a proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

 Responsibilities

 The Power Platform Admin/Developer will manage client’s Power Platform environment, build power application, automated workflows, agent and code apps. This apprentice role will be embedded with a Senior Cloud Architect and Power Platform administrator. The role will shadow the Power Platform administrator to learn client's processes, demonstrate the successful knowledge transfer then work independently. The responsibilities will evolve to work with business users to configure, troubleshoot and provide guidance for applications, flows, and agents. Additionally, the role will include custom development for client's business units.

 **Core Responsibilities** 

• Work Power Platform service requests. 
 
• Assist businesses units with environment setup, troubleshooting, recommendations, etc. 
 
• Gather and document solution requirements from business stakeholders. 
 
• Develop proof-of-concepts and transition successful prototypes into production systems. 
 
• Design and implement pipelines for Power Platforms applications. 
 
• Coach business personnel on the basics of Power Platform. 
 
• Write clean, efficient software code and scripts for workflows. 
 
• Conduct rigorous testing and quality assurance. 
 
• Ensure compliance with organizational IT governance, security, and audit standards. 
 
 **Stakeholder Engagement & Communication** 

• Act as liaison between the Information Technology Division, business stakeholders, and application developers. 
 
• Facilitate requirements gathering and ensure clarity in solution design. 
 
• Communicate progress, risks, and issues to project sponsors and leadership teams. 
 
 **Delivery Excellence & Governance** 

• Ensure development projects comply with client’s IT governance, security, and audit requirements. 
 
• Promote reusable components and standardized AI development practices. 
 
• Conduct post-implementation reviews to capture lessons learned and improve delivery methods. 
 
 **Team Coordination & Support** 

• Collaborate with developer, cloud architects, business analysts, and infrastructure teams. 
 
• Provide guidance, best practices and assist in troubleshooting. 
 
• Support knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the team. 
 
 Qualifications

 Minimum (Required): 

 Years 

 Skills/Experience 

 Degree in Computer Science or related field with studies in software design, programming languages, cloud computing, database management, and advance data structures

 Python – comfortable writing and debugging Python code, developed through coursework, internships, or personal projects

 Development languages – comfortable with React, Typescript, C#, or Java developed through coursework, internships, or personal projects

 Version Control - Experience using Git/GitHub for collaborative developmentDatabases - Working knowledge of SQL

 Communication & Problem-Solving - Strong analytical skills and a demonstrated willingness to learn production engineering practices (Docker, CI/CD, cloud deployment) on the job

 Preferred (Optional): 

 Years 

 Skills/Experience 

 Any exposure to Microsoft's Power Platform environments through use of the platform or self-paced training

 #LI-CP1
fit_why: Power Platform low-code focus; candidate's React/TypeScript/SQL/CI overlap is strong

role: Motorsport Software and Data Analytics Graduate Intern
jd:
We Are Bosch. 
 At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our areas of activity are every bit as diverse as our outstanding Bosch teams around the world. Their creativity is the key to innovation through connected living, mobility, or industry.
 Let’s grow together, enjoy more, and inspire each other.  Work #LikeABosch  
 
• Reinvent yourself:  At Bosch, you will evolve. 
• Discover new directions:  At Bosch, you will find your place. 
• Balance your life:  At Bosch, your job matches your lifestyle. 
• Celebrate success:  At Bosch, we celebrate you. 
• Be yourself:  At Bosch, we value values. 
• Shape tomorrow:  At Bosch, you change lives.

Job Description 
 Welcome to Bosch Motorsport, a premier supplier of electronics, sensors, actuators, and engineering services to top racing series (Formula 1, IMSA, IndyCar, NASCAR, SuperGT, WEC, WRC), manufactures, and teams worldwide. Here at Bosch Motorsport North America, you'll be part of a growing, dynamic, and entrepreneurial team, taking on challenging tasks.
 We are seeking a highly motived and passionate graduate engineer to join our team. This role allows you to play a key role in the development, testing, and application of key components for Bosch Motorsport globally. Embrace this opportunity to make an impact in the exciting world of motorsport technology!
 What You Will Do 
 The Motorsport Software and Data Analytics Graduate Intern will be paired with an experienced engineering mentor and will work alongside simulation and software development engineers to support the development, integration, validation, and optimization of electronic systems, connectivity solutions, and software applications for professional motorsport customers across North America and global racing programs. The Graduate Intern will have dedicated project(s) and own the key deliverables by the end of the work term.

 This role provides hands-on experience in a fast-paced, high-performance motorsport environment and will include multiple of the following attribute areas (not necessarily all):
 
• Simulation & Performance Analysis: Support vehicle and power unit simulation activities, sensitivity analysis, model development, and comparison of simulation results with dyno, test, and track data. 
• Data Analysis & Visualization: Analyze and visualize simulation and telemetry data using MATLAB, Python, WinDarab (our specialized data evaluation and analysis tool) and other engineering tools to support performance evaluation and technical decision-making. 
• System Testing & Validation: Support Hardware-In-the-Loop, cloud, and system-level testing for complex controls systems; analyze results, investigate discrepancies, and document findings. 
• Telemetry & Trackside Engineering: Support the development, testing, and deployment of motorsport connectivity and telemetry systems, including possible opportunities to assist with track and test events. 
• Application Engineering Support: Work alongside engineers to understand customer requirements and support motorsport products and services, including powertrain controls systems and telemetry and cloud-based data solutions. 
• Automation & Process Improvement: Develop scripts, dashboards, and automated analysis or reporting workflows using MATLAB, Python, C#, or similar tools. 
• Technical Project Ownership: Take ownership of defined graduate-level projects in simulation, telemetry, data analytics, automation, or performance analysis, with guidance from experienced engineers. 
• Structured Mentorship and Professional Development: Partner with an assigned full-time engineer to receive peer-to-peer technical guidance, prioritize daily deliverables, and build foundational motorsport engineering skills. This is also an opportunity for reverse mentoring.

Required Qualifications 
 
• Currently pursuing a Masters or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or Data Science or in a dual degree program from an accredited four-year college or university in Engineering, Computer Science, or Data Science/Analytics 
• Minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 
• Must be 18 years or older 
• 3+ years of hands-on motorsport or relevant experience with vehicle, ICE and/or hybrid controls (industry, FSAE, EcoCar, etc.)  
 Desired Qualifications 
 Hands-on Automotive Experience: Practical, hands-on vehicle controls systems experience related to combustion engines, high voltage hybrid systems, data acquisition systems, wiring harness design, sensor application, and/or mechanical troubleshooting (e.g., project cars, Formula SAE, or shop experience).
 Programming and Scripting: Programming or scripting experience (e.g., Python, MATLAB, C#, C++, embedded Linux) for data processing, automation, or testing purposes. Appropriate and responsible use of AI for acceleration of both technical and daily tasks.
 Modeling and Simulation: Modeling and simulation experience (e.g., Matlab/Simulink) developing and refining plant models and/or developing and integration of Functional Mock-up Unit container files for Hardware-In-the-Loop or Driver-In-the-Loop test environments
 Automotive Communications and Networking: Foundational knowledge of automotive communications (e.g., CAN, Ethernet) and wired/wireless networking (e.g., LAN, WAN).
 Diagnostic Tool Proficiency: Experience with industry standard diagnostic, testing, and measurement tools (e.g., Vector tools, dSPACE products, oscilloscopes)
 Demonstrated Leadership & Technical Research: Project work with full end to end scope ownership in work delivery. Graduate research, technical leadership, design reports, publications, or significant independent projects related to automotive, motorsport, connectivity, simulation, telemetry, or powertrain engineering.
  
  Ideal Candidate Characteristics 
 Motorsport Passion and Drive: Possesses a genuine enthusiasm for professional motorsport and an eagerness to make meaningful technical contributions.
 Proactive Self-Starter: Thrives in an agile, hands-on environment; takes initiative to ask questions, research solutions, and execute tasks with accountability.
 Data-Driven and Adaptable: Approaches engineering problems with objective logic, pivoting quickly when requirements change.
 Disciplined Team Player: Communicates test observations and data findings clearly (both verbally and in writing) while collaborating seamlessly within a multi-disciplinary team.
 Curiosity and Growth Mindset: Eager to step outside of immediate academic comfort zone to learn new software skills, hardware implementations, and systems.

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability / veterans  
 *Bosch adheres to Federal, State, and Local laws regarding drug-testing. Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a drug screen and background check. Candidates who have been offered the position must pass both screenings before their start date.  
 Your well-being matters at Bosch! We offer a competitive compensation and a benefits package designed to empower you in every area of your life. This includes premium health coverage, a 401(k) with generous matching, resources for financial planning and goal setting, ample paid time off, parental leave, and comprehensive life and disability protection. We're investing in your success!
fit_why: Requires Masters/PhD enrollment, 3+ years motorsport and controls experience

Company Description

Backed by leading climate and American dynamism investors, Terranova builds intelligent robotic systems to terraform the Earth itself - lifting land, restoring wetlands, and protecting critical infrastructure from floods and sea-level rise.

Our mission is to preserve the built environment, create new habitats, and usher in an era of abundance. Our work supports climate resilience, disaster recovery, and defense across the United States and beyond.

We’re assembling a world-class team that wants to work on something real, physical, and civilization-scale. If you want your work to reshape the world (literally), this is the place to do it.



What to to Expect

We are seeking a software engineering intern for Spring 2027 who can design and maintain modern, scalable applications while owning our cloud and infrastructure layer. You’ll build responsive user interfaces, develop backend APIs, and architect deployments that can scale globally. You’ll thrive if you’ve worked on platform or infra teams (Cloudflare, Vercel, AWS) or as a product engineer at performance-oriented orgs (Stripe, Notion, etc.). Check out plan.terranova.inc http://plan.terranova.inc for an idea of some of the web dev stuff you'll need to develop. 



What You’ll Do

 - Design and implement performant, maintainable web apps powered by Vue / Nuxt / TypeScript, and backends written in NestJS, Rust, or Go.

 - Build and operate distributed backends with Postgres, TimescaleDB, and a desire to work with serverless constraints.

 - Implement CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and incident-response workflows, a'la Sentry or DataDog.

 - Collaborate with product and robotics teams to integrate data, telemetry, and control interfaces.

 - Build customer facing and internal tools

 - Full stack application development

 - Comfortable with the pace and intensity of early-stage startup life

 - Working towards a bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or related field

 - U.S. permanent residency required

 - Ability to be on-site part-time required 



Preferred Skills and Experience

 - History of making stuff - hobby projects, industry experience

 - TypeScript

 - Vue/Nuxt.js

 - NestJS/Rust/Go

 - Postgres/TimescaleDB/queues

 - GitHub Actions/Argo

 - OpenTelemetry/DataDog/Sentry

 - iOS and Android app development, with a focus on cross-platform programming
   
   

Compensation and Timeline

 - $25-35/hr + relocation + company perks

 - Spring Internship from January-May depending on your school schedule
fit_why: Full-stack TypeScript match, but Vue/Nuxt and NestJS/Rust/Go are gaps

Software Engineer Intern (AI-Native) — Fall 2026

We’re looking for engineers who don’t just use AI tools — you build with them.

At Kognitos, you’ll work on real product problems using tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI-assisted workflows. You’ll ship fast, learn faster, and operate in a highly iterative environment alongside experienced engineers.

This is not a “watch and learn” internship — you’ll be writing production code, contributing to core systems, and helping shape how we build.

What You’ll Do

 - Build and ship features end-to-end with the engineering team

 - Use AI-native tooling (Claude, Cursor, etc.) to accelerate development workflows

 - Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code

 - Participate in code reviews and technical discussions

 - Debug issues and improve system performance

 - Contribute to projects across AI, automation, and data systems

 - Move quickly, test ideas, and iterate in a fast-paced environment

What We’re Looking For

 - Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience)

 - Strong fundamentals in programming (Python, JavaScript, or similar)

 - Comfortable building with modern dev tools and workflows

 - Familiar with Git and collaborative development

 - Solid understanding of core CS concepts (data structures, algorithms, systems basics)

 - Strong problem-solving ability and curiosity

 - Clear communicator and team-oriented

Bonus Points

 - Experience using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.)

 - Built projects using LLMs, APIs, or automation workflows

 - Familiarity with modern web stacks (React, Node, etc.)

 - Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)

 - Prior internship, startup, or side project experience



FINAL NOTE

You do not need to match all of the listed expectations to apply for this position. We are committed to building a team with a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES PROVIDER

Kognitos is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

WHO WE ARE

Serval http://serval.com/ is the AI-native enterprise service management platform that automates the work legacy IT service management tools only track. Our AI agents build the automations that power employee support, then resolve requests against them instantly—helping teams across IT, HR, finance, legal, and beyond automate work within one governed platform.

Companies including Fox, Live Nation, Notion, Ramp, and Lucid Motors run on Serval. Headquartered in San Francisco, we’ve raised $277 million from investors including Sequoia Capital, Redpoint Ventures, First Round, General Catalyst, and Elad Gil, most recently a $150 million Series C at a $3 billion valuation.

We’re building a team that moves quickly, takes ownership, and wants to make a meaningful impact on how the world’s largest organizations work. Come help us build what’s next for enterprise service management.




ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Software Engineer Intern, Backend at Serval, you’ll work directly on core parts of our platform as we build AI-powered automation for modern IT teams. This is a hands-on internship where you’ll contribute real production code, learn how an early-stage product is built, and see your work shipped to customers.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Work closely with our CTO and founding engineering team to build and extend backend product capabilities.

 - Contribute to backend services that power Serval’s AI-driven automation workflows.

 - Learn how to design, implement, and test scalable systems in a production environment.

 - Help us move quickly toward key product milestones, including shipping and iterating on core platform features.




WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field with an expected graduation date between Dec 2026 - 2028

 - Strong fundamentals in computer science (data structures, algorithms, systems).

 - Familiarity with at least one backend programming language (Go, Java, Python, or similar).

 - Clear communication skills and the ability to learn quickly in a fast-moving environment.

 - Excitement about startups, ownership, and building products from the ground up.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Exposure to modern backend or cloud technologies (APIs, microservices, containers, or cloud platforms).

 - Experience with any part of our stack: Go, gRPC, Kubernetes, React, TypeScript, AWS, or Terraform.

 - Previous internship or project experience at a startup or fast-paced team.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Impact: Be a key player in shaping the success of our product and company.

 - Growth: Build a fundamentally new AI product offering with the support of our experienced team and investors. Grow rapidly with the company.

 - Culture: Join a culture that values innovation, ownership, accountability, and fun.
fit_why: Backend intern: Python/Java/TypeScript, APIs, containers, startup fit
